Last Thursday I visited Boa Vista farm, near Varginha. I left the office at seven in the morning, and I drove for one hour. At the farm, I met the producer, Mr. Silva, and his son. I brought the EUDR checklist and the farm map. We walked around the property together. I found two small problems. There was no training record for the workers, and one boundary on the map was wrong. I took twenty photos as evidence. On Friday, I wrote the visit report, and I sent it to Emma in Geneva.

Hi Carlos, it's Emma. I read your visit report yesterday. Thank you, it was very clear. I have three short questions. First, did Mr. Silva sign the corrective action plan? Second, did you take photos of the new boundary? And third, when did the farm get its last certificate? Please reply by email before Friday. Oh, and one more thing. I met the buyers from Germany this morning, and they liked your report very much. Good job, Carlos. Talk soon.
